name: Living Icon of Wrath
summary: Once per long rest, for 1 minute, your Fury of Faith applies to every melee hit rather than once per turn. If you would drop to 0 hit points during this minute, you may immediately use Martyr’s Mercy on yourself before falling unconscious.
